name: gpu-server-setup
description: Prepare a Linux server with NVIDIA or Intel Arc GPUs for LLM and neural-network workloads: NVIDIA driver + CUDA from the official repo or the in-tree Intel i915/xe driver with distro firmware, Docker Engine with verified GPU access (NVIDIA Container Toolkit or /dev/dri passthrough) as the mandatory base, staged verification gates for both vendors, optional docker-compose presets for vLLM, Infinity, OpenWebUI and Ollama plus Intel Arc stacks (llama.cpp SYCL/Vulkan, Ollama, OpenVINO, vLLM), GPU power limits persisted via systemd, case fans driven by GPU temperature and Intel Arc idle-power fixes (ASPM).
